title: 무역보험법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20251001:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Trade and Industry and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Rule No. 1, Oct. 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation; provided, any provisions amending ministerial ordinances promulgated before the enforcement date of these Rules but not yet in force among those amended pursuant to Article 5 of these Addenda shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those ordinances.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (12) Omitted.

(13) The Enforcement Rules of the Trade Insurance Act are partially amended as follows:

The term "Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy" in the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 2 (1), Article 2 (2), the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 3, Article 4, and the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 5 is replaced with "Minister of Trade and Industry", respectively.

(14) through (54) Omitted.
